sentences.en: OFFICER
sentences.zh: OFFICER。

sentences.en: Good morning
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: What can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的？

sentences.en: LOUISE: I want to report a theft. had some things stolen out of my bag yesterday
sentences.zh: LOUISE：我想报案，昨天我包里的一些东西被盗了。

sentences.en: OFFICER: I'm sorry to hear that
sentences.zh: OFFICER：很抱歉听到这个消息。

sentences.en: Right, so 'Il a need to take a few details
sentences.zh: 好的，我需要记录一些细节。

sentences.en: Can I start with your name?
sentences.zh: 我可以先问一下您的姓名吗？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Louise Taylor
sentences.zh: LOUISE：路易丝·泰勒。

sentences.en: OK, thank you
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: And are you resident in the UK?
sentences.zh: 您是英国居民吗？

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: OFFICER:
sentences.zh: OFFICER：

sentences.en: LOUISE: No, I'm actually Canadian, though my mother was British
sentences.zh: LOUISE：不，我其实是加拿大人，不过我母亲是英国人。

sentences.en: OFFICER: And your date of birth?
sentences.zh: OFFICER：您的出生日期是？

sentences.en: LOUISE: December 14th, 1977
sentences.zh: LOUISE：1977年12月14日。

sentences.en: OFFICER: So you're just visiting this country?
sentences.zh: OFFICER：所以您只是来这个国家短期访问？

sentences.en: LOUISE: That's right. come over most summers on business
sentences.zh: LOUISE：没错。我每年夏天都因公来英国。

sentences.en: I'm an interior designer and I come over to buy old furniture, antiques you know
sentences.zh: 我是一名室内设计师，来这儿购买旧家具和古董之类的。

sentences.en: There are some really lovely things around here, but you need to get out to the small towns
sentences.zh: 这里确实有一些非常漂亮的东西，但您得去小城镇才能找到。

sentences.en: I've had a really good trip this year, until this happened
sentences.zh: 今年我的行程一直非常顺利，直到这件事发生。

sentences.en: OFFICER: OK
sentences.zh: OFFICER：好的。

sentences.en: So you've been here quite a while?
sentences.zh: 所以您已经在这里待了一段时间了？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Yes, I'm here for two months
sentences.zh: LOUISE：是的，我这次待两个月。

sentences.en: I go back next week
sentences.zh: 我下周就回去了。

sentences.en: OFFICER: So may I ask where you're staying now?
sentences.zh: OFFICER：那么请问您目前住在哪里？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Well at present I've got a place at Park Apartments, that's on King Street
sentences.zh: LOUISE：目前我住在国王街的公园公寓。

sentences.en: I was staying at the Riverside Apartments on the same street, but the apartment there was only available for six weeks so I had to find another one
sentences.zh: 之前我住在同一条街上的河畔公寓，但那里的公寓只租六周，所以我不得不另找一处。

sentences.en: OFFICER: OK
sentences.zh: OFFICER：好的。

sentences.en: And the apartment number?
sentences.zh: 那么公寓号码是？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Fifteen
sentences.zh: LOUISE：15号。

sentences.en: LOUISE: Right
sentences.zh: LOUISE：好的。

sentences.en: OFFICER: Now, I need to take some details of the theft
sentences.zh: OFFICER：现在我需要记录一些关于盗窃案的细节。

sentences.en: So you said you had some things stolen out of your bag?
sentences.zh: 您刚才说您包里有些东西被盗了？

sentences.en: LOUISE: That's right
sentences.zh: LOUISE：是的。

sentences.en: OFFICER: And were you actually carrying the bag when the theft took place?
sentences.zh: OFFICER：盗窃发生时，您当时正背着那个包吗？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Yes
sentences.zh: LOUISE：是的。

sentences.en: I really can't understand it
sentences.zh: 我实在无法理解。

sentences.en: I had my backpack on
sentences.zh: 我当时背着双肩背包。

sentences.en: And went into a supermarket to buy a few things and when I opened it up t my wallet wasn't there
sentences.zh: 然后进了一家超市买些东西，等我打开包时，发现钱包不见了。

sentences.en: OFFICER: And what did your wallet have in it?
sentences.zh: OFFICER：那么您的钱包里都有些什么？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Well, fortunately I don't keep my credit cards in that wallet - I keep them with my passport in an inside compartment in my backpack
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 好在，我的信用卡并不放在那个钱包里——我把它们和护照一起放在背包内侧的夹层里。

sentences.en: But there was quite a bit of cash there ... about £250 sterling, I should think
sentences.zh: 但钱包里确实有不少现金……我想大概有250英镑。

sentences.en: I withdrew £300 from my account yesterday, but I did a bit of shopping, a so must have already spent about £50 of that
sentences.zh: 我昨天从账户里取了300英镑，不过买了一些东西，所以应该已经花掉了其中大约50英镑。

sentences.en: OFFICER: OK
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 好的。

sentences.en: LOUISE: At first thought, oh must have left the wallet back in the apartment, but then I realised my phone had gone as well
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 起初我以为自己把钱包落在公寓里了，但后来我意识到连手机也不见了。

sentences.en: It was only a week old, and a that's when I realised I'd been robbed
sentences.zh: 那部手机才买了一周，就在那时我才意识到自己遭窃了。

sentences.en: Anyway at least they didn't take the keys to my rental car
sentences.zh: 不过至少他们没拿走我租用车的钥匙。

sentences.en: OFFICER: Yes
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 是的。

sentences.en: So you say the theft occurred yesterday?
sentences.zh: 那么您说盗窃发生在昨天？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Yes
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 是的。

sentences.en: OFFICER: So that was September the tenth
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 所以就是9月10日。

sentences.en: And do you have any idea at all of where or when the things might possibly have been stolen?
sentences.zh: 您是否能确定物品可能是在何时、何地被盗的？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Well at first I couldn't believe it because the bag had been on my back ever since left the apartment after lunch
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 起初我简直不敢相信，因为自午饭后离开公寓起，那只包就一直背在我背上。

sentences.en: It's just a small backpack, but I generally use it when I'm travelling because it seems safer than a handbag
sentences.zh: 它只是一个小型背包，但我旅行时通常用它，因为它看起来比手提包更安全。

sentences.en: Anyway, I met up with a friend, and we spent a couple of hours in the museum
sentences.zh: 后来，我和一位朋友碰了面，一起在博物馆待了几个小时。

sentences.en: But I do remember that as we were leaving there, at a about 4 o'clock, a group of young boys ran up to us, and they were really crowding round us, and they were asking us what time it was, then all of a sudden they ran off
sentences.zh: 但我记得，我们大约下午4点离开博物馆时，一群小男孩突然朝我们跑来，紧紧围住我们，还问我们几点了；接着，他们突然一哄而散。

sentences.en: OFFICER
sentences.zh: OFFICER:

sentences.en: Can you remember anything about them?
sentences.zh: 您能回忆起关于他们的任何细节吗？

sentences.en: LOUISE: The one who did most of the talking was wearing a T-shirt with a picture of a something ... let's see ... a tiger
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 其中那个说话最多的孩子穿着一件T恤，上面印着某种图案……让我想想……是一只老虎。

sentences.en: OFFICER: Right
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 好的。

sentences.en: Any idea of how old he might have been?
sentences.zh: 您能估计一下他大概多大年纪吗？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Around twelve years old?
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 大概十二岁左右？

sentences.en: OFFICER: And can you remember anything else about his appearance?
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 您还能想起他外貌上的其他特征吗？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Not much
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 想不起太多。

sentences.en: He was quite thin
sentences.zh: 他身材相当瘦削……

sentences.en: OFFICER: Colour of hair?
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 头发是什么颜色？

sentences.en: LOUISE: do remember that - he was blond
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 这个我记得——他是金发。

sentences.en: All the others were dark-haired
sentences.zh: 其他孩子都是深色头发。

sentences.en: OFFICER: And any details of the others?
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 那其他人呢，您能提供什么细节吗？

sentences.en: LOUISE: Not really
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 实在想不起来了。

sentences.en: They came and went so quickly
sentences.zh: 他们来去太快了。

sentences.en: OFFICER: Right
sentences.zh: OFFICER: 好的。

sentences.en: So what I'm going to do now is give you a crime reference number so you can contact your insurance company
sentences.zh: 接下来，我将为您提供一个案件编号，以便您联系保险公司。

sentences.en: So this is ten digits: 87954 82361
LOUISE: Thank you
sentences.zh: LOUISE: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So should
sentences.zh: 那么我该……
